summary_en: EBC-129 is being tested alone and together with pembrolizumab in adults with advanced solid tumours. EBC-129 is given as an intravenous infusion over 30 to 120 minutes on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle, and pembrolizumab is given at 200 mg intravenously every 21 days. The study measures safety and tolerability; the phase is Phase 1.
summary_es: EBC-129 se está probando solo y junto con pembrolizumab en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados. EBC-129 se administra como infusión intravenosa de 30 a 120 minutos el día 1 de cada ciclo de 21 días, y pembrolizumab se administra a 200 mg por vía intravenosa cada 21 días. El estudio mide la seguridad y la tolerabilidad; la fase es la 1.
who_for: Adults aged 18 or older (21 or older in Singapore).

not_for: Unable or unwilling to provide a tumour tissue sample, unless biopsy poses significant risk.
Anti-cancer or investigational therapy within 28 days before study drug, or concurrent anti-cancer therapy.
Pregnancy or breastfeeding, or active HIV, hepatitis B or hepatitis C infection.
